player_prompt.intro:
Wɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɔ 2048 wɔ {board_size}x{board_size} bɔdu. Wo dɔ pa ara ne sɛ wɔtwaa {target_tile} tile gu ahyɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ mu!
Nsɛm a ɛfata: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Mpaeduwa no bɔ abɔntsen na ɛyɛ kɛse wɔ ɔkɔmfo no mu.

invalid_move.no_change: Akwankyerɛ kuw no ansesa - paw ɔkwan foforo bi.

outcome.win: Ayɛ wo adze! Woetwaa {target_tile}! Score akɔnsɔn {score}.
outcome.lose: Nkɔmmɔdie nni hɔ bio. Tile a ɛkɔɔ fam {max_tile} - nkontabuo a etwa to {score}.
